description_en: Collects a single public web page into the current user's personal knowledge base
description_zh: 采集单个公开网页到当前用户的个人知识库
name: CreatePersonalPublicUrl

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The URL of the public HTTP/HTTPS web page
parameters.help_zh: 公开 HTTP/HTTPS 网页 URL
parameters.name: original_url

parameters.help_en: The resource name. If omitted, the URL is used
parameters.help_zh: 资源名称；省略时使用 URL
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target personal directory. If not specified, the current user's default personal root directory is used
parameters.help_zh: 目标个人目录 ID；不传时使用当前用户默认个人根目录
parameters.name: directory_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the operating object
parameters.name: operating_object_name

parameters.help_en: The list of resource tag JSON strings
parameters.help_zh: 资源标签 JSON 字符串列表
parameters.name: source_tags

200.description_en: 采集公开网页到个人知识库
200.description_zh: 采集公开网页到个人知识库

schema.description_en: The response for collecting a public web page into the personal knowledge base
schema.description_zh: 采集公开网页到个人知识库

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success

directoryId.description_en: The ID of the target personal directory specified in the request. This value is empty when the default root directory is used
directoryId.description_zh: 请求指定的目标个人目录 ID；默认根目录场景为空

gmtCreate.description_en: The creation time in ISO 8601 format

message.description_en: The error description. This value is empty if the request is successful

originalUrl.description_en: The submitted public web page URL
originalUrl.description_zh: 已提交的公开网页 URL

scope.description_en: The resource scope. This value is fixed to PERSONAL

sourceId.description_en: The ID of the newly created source

status.description_en: The resource status. A value of RUNNING indicates that the request has been accepted but crawling and parsing are not yet complete
status.description_zh: 资源状态；RUNNING 表示已受理，尚未完成抓取和解析
